Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 10  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly compared the ages of the directors at the time their films were released, rather than comparing their birth dates directly to determine who is younger. The task was to find which director is younger, not who was younger at the time of their film's release. This led to the incorrect conclusion that Reginald Le Borg was younger based on the release dates of the films, rather than their actual ages.
